::: {#def-computational-graph}

#### Computational graph

A **computational graph** of a calculation has one node for each variable,
whether an input, a [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) or an intermediate result,
and an arrow from each node to every node computed from it
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 6.5.1].
It has no cycles: following the arrows never returns to a node.

:::
